svg.title: goatcore at a pinned release, plus this overlay, is one goatnet
svg.desc: goatcore at goatcore/v0.6.1 holds the code: plays, the ops/scripts/ tools and the image builds. This repository holds only what the environment owns: four facts in goatlite.yaml (name zagros, host 192.0.2.10, ssh_user ubuntu, admin admin@example.org) and what is rendered from them (ops/ansible/group_vars/zagros_hosts/, ops/ansible/inventory/, ops/pins/, ops/enrollment/). Copying the overlay over a goatcore checkout gives one tree; standing it up gives the LAN goatnet zagros: one box, mgmt-zagros-01, with the DNS zone zagros.lan served by the host and peers enrolling over the LAN.
svg.text: goatcore at a pinned release, plus this overlay, is one goatnet
zagros is built from invented facts: every value in this repository is an example.
